title: eDrive40
sources:
- BMW USA i4 — https://www.bmwusa.com/vehicles/bmw-i-series/i4/bmw-i4-gran-coupe.html
- EPA fueleconomy.gov — https://www.fueleconomy.gov/feg/Find.do?action=sbs&id=47265
- IIHS — https://www.iihs.org/ratings/vehicle/bmw/i4-4-door-sedan/2025
- US News — https://cars.usnews.com/cars-trucks/bmw/i4
infotainment: BMW iDrive 8.5 with curved 14.9-inch + 12.3-inch display, OTA-updatable, wireless CarPlay & Android Auto, 5G connectivity, Hey BMW voice assistant
adasStandard: Active Driving Assistant (forward collision warning, automatic emergency braking, lane departure warning, blind spot detection, rear cross-traffic alert, speed limit info). Source: https://www.bmwusa.com/vehicles/bmw-i-series/i4/bmw-i4-gran-coupe.html
adasOptional: Driving Assistance Professional Package — Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go, Active Lane Keeping Assistant, Traffic Jam Assistant (hands-on Level 2), Highway Assistant (hands-off Level 2 on mapped highways up to 85 mph), Emergency Stop Assistant, Evasion Aid. Source: https://www.bmwusa.com/vehicles/bmw-i-series/i4/bmw-i4-gran-coupe.html
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard rear-view camera with dynamic guidelines. Multi-angle view and reversing assistant available via Parking Assistance Package. Source: https://www.bmwusa.com/vehicles/bmw-i-series/i4/bmw-i4-gran-coupe.html
sideViewCameraNotes: Surround View 360 with 3D View available via Parking Assistance Package. No standalone side-blind camera. Source: BMW USA i4 build page.
subscriptionFeatures: BMW ConnectedDrive offers optional post-purchase upgrades / subscriptions: Driving Assistance Professional, BMW Drive Recorder, Traffic Camera Information (region-dependent), Remote Engine Start. Heated-seat subscription was discontinued in late 2023; heated seats now ship as a one-time option. Source: https://www.thedrive.com/news/bmw-commits-to-subscriptions-even-after-heated-seat-debacle
drmNotes: i4 operates fully offline for primary driving functions. Connectivity (eSIM via Verizon, no extra cost for 4 yrs of BMW Assist eCall and basic ConnectedDrive) required for remote app control, OTA updates, BMW Maps live traffic, Plug & Charge at EA Superchargers, and remote climate. Source: https://www.bmwusa.com/explore/connecteddrive.html
killSwitchNotes: No federally-mandated impaired-driving kill switch hardware/software present on MY2025. Active Driving Assistant Pro uses an interior driver-attention camera for hands-off monitoring but does not act as an impairment cutout. Source: https://www.motor1.com/news/794316/new-cars-mandate-impaired-driver-detection-delay/
knownIssues: iDrive 8 software glitches (rebooting screens, navigation freezes) reported on MY2022-2024; partially addressed via OTA. Some early i4 owners report 12V battery drain when vehicle sits unused for extended periods. Source: https://www.bmwblog.com/forums/ and NHTSA owner complaints.
recalls: Multiple software-related recalls in 2023-2024 covering iDrive infotainment instability and high-voltage battery management. Check NHTSA recalls.gov for VIN-specific status. Source: https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls
stateIncentives: BMW i4 is assembled in Munich, Germany and is not eligible for the federal IRA EV tax credit (final assembly outside North America). State-level: CA CVRP ended 2023; eligible for HOV-lane access in CA (white sticker for BEVs). NY Drive Clean rebate $500 (income-capped). NJ exempt from state sales tax. Source: https://www.fueleconomy.gov/feg/taxevb.shtml
